cases.name: Priest of Possibility
cases.text: When this creature enters, look at the top seven cards of your library. If a card among them has flying, this creature perpetually gains flying. The same is true for first strike, double strike, deathtouch, haste, hexproof, indestructible, lifelink, menace, protection, reach, trample, and vigilance. Then shuffle.
